content:
Agent asked: I need a bit more info to proceed. `git` is not installed on this machine and I can't run `sudo` in a non-interactive shell. Also, could you confirm which GitHub repository you want to clone? There are several repos named "Grepo" on GitHub — please share the full URL or `owner/repo` path (e.g. `username/Grepo`).

User replied: Install git manually first (e.g. via your terminal: `sudo apt-get install -y git`), then share the full GitHub URL of the Grepo repo you want to clone.
